name: InterCode-CTF
intro: InterCode-CTF 是一个面向语言智能体的交互式网络安全基准。作者从 picoCTF 人工解答、重建并在 Docker 中复验 100 个任务，要求智能体在十轮内通过 Python/Bash 操作资源并提交正确 flag。
build_method: 从 picoCTF 人工解题与收集；还原完整数字资源；构建任务级 Ubuntu Docker；逐题人工复验
metric: Task Success Rate, 已解任务平均轮数, 分类别成功率
modality: 文本, 代码, 文件资源
task_type: 网络安全, Capture the Flag, 交互式 Shell
eval_feature: 十轮工具交互, 任务级 Docker, stdout/错误反馈, flag 精确判分
scale: 100 个 CTF 任务，覆盖 6 类网络安全技能
task_type_en: Cybersecurity, Capture the Flag, Interactive Shell
build_method_en: Manually solve and collect picoCTF challenges, recreate exact digital assets, build task-specific Ubuntu Docker environments, and manually re-verify every task
eval_feature_en: Ten-turn Tool Interaction, Task-specific Docker, stdout/Error Feedback, Exact Flag Scoring
intro_en: InterCode-CTF is an interactive cybersecurity benchmark for language agents. The authors manually solve, recreate, and verify 100 picoCTF tasks in Docker; agents then use Python or Bash over ten turns to inspect task assets and submit the correct flag.
scale_en: 100 CTF tasks across six cybersecurity-skill categories
metric_en: Task Success Rate, Average Turns on Solved Tasks, Category-level Success
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the dedicated NeurIPS 2023 Multi-Agent Security workshop paper, OpenReview:KOZwk7BFc3, and the official princeton-nlp/intercode CTF implementation. Task authors first solve picoCTF challenges, download the exact code, images, executables, archives, and other digital resources, record the hidden picoCTF flag, and recreate every task as query, gold, source, tags, and task_assets/{task_id}. Each instance runs in a task-specific asset directory inside an Ubuntu/Bourne-shell Docker sandbox with Python, GCC, GDB, and security tooling. The authors manually re-solve every recreated task to verify assets, dependencies, feasibility, and the flag; two CTF-experienced authors produced 100 verified problems in six hours. The paper suite contains 33 General Skills, 27 Reverse Engineering, 19 Cryptography, 15 Forensics, 4 Binary Exploitation, and 2 Web Exploitation tasks. During evaluation the agent receives the instruction, emits Python or Bash actions, observes stdout or errors, and has ten interactions. A case-insensitive exact match between submit picoCTF{...} and the gold flag gives reward 1; otherwise the task is unsolved. The paper reports task success rate, average solved turns, and category breakdown, with the GPT-4 baseline solving 40/100 in 3.9 turns on average.
